head: WORKTREE
summary: e2e-tests module has no production code, drives both services via HTTP only, and covers happy path, rejection and compensation. Profile, CI job and README are in place. Only the local green run is unconfirmed (not run here).

acceptance_criteria.evidence: LedgerFlowStack.java: both images, a PostgreSQL per service, Kafka and Schema Registry (MessagingContainers images) on one network. Images are built by docker build outside Testcontainers (scripts/e2e.sh, CI build-push-action), a stated deviation.
pom.xml profile e2e adds the module; ci.yml job 'e2e'; README line with scripts/e2e.sh.

findings.description: B1 says images are built 'from their Dockerfiles' by Testcontainers; the implementation builds them with docker build beforehand. The class javadoc explains it, but the brief does not record the decision.
findings.suggestion: Note the pre-built image decision in the brief or PR description.

findings.description: B4 refusal is a currency mismatch; the brief's example is a creditor posting the ledger refuses, which this satisfies, but only one refusal cause is exercised. Acceptable for a smoke test.
